Reviewed both full proof steps and twelve direct prerequisite statements. Absolute first moments follow from L1 plus M2<infinity. Smooth Taylor remainder and centered moments cancel the linear term. Weighted Cauchy-Schwarz with total weight M2/2, followed by Tonelli and translation invariance, gives the exact h^2*M2/2 Frobenius-Hessian bound. For Borel q in L2, weighted Holder/Tonelli gives almost-everywhere absolute existence and operator norm <=||K||1; null-set changes disappear under translations and Tonelli. Smooth density in W2,2 applies for p=2 under AC_omega, and the deliberately loose d*epsilon bound covers repeated mixed derivatives. Epsilon approximation needs no arbitrary family of choices. All h>0 and signed kernels are covered; M2=0 creates no division. Reader source locator correction is accepted; no claim/dependency interface changed. Reviewed all five steps and eighteen direct suppliers. Joint Borel measurability licenses Tonelli before finiteness. Integrated absolute and square summand moments are exactly ||K||1 and h^(-d)||K||2^2; hence a common full-measure set has finite moments. Positive/negative parts derive the signed density formula, and affine substitution identifies expectation with the L2 convolution. Independence kills centered cross terms, bounding integrated variance by ||K||2^2/(n*h^d). The reviewed W2,2 bias supplier gives h^4*M2^2*||D2f||2,F^2/4; pointwise bias-variance identity holds almost everywhere and Tonelli yields finite MISE. n=1, every h>0, signed K and arbitrary Borel density versions in the Sobolev class are covered; no boundedness of f is assumed. h=n^(-1/(d+4)) balances the two powers exactly. This is only an upper rate, not a lower bound. AC_omega is explicit. Reader APTS locator correction is sound. Reviewed all three proof steps and thirteen direct suppliers. Bounded continuous f and K in L1 intersect L2 imply finite first and square moments for every h>0, including signed K. Measurable transforms preserve independence; product factorization gives zero centered cross terms. Exact variance is (E Z1^2-(E Z1)^2)/(n*h^(2d)). DCT with ||f||infinity*K^2 gives the leading term, and the mean-square subtraction is O(1/n), hence little-o of 1/(n*h^d) since h->0. The displayed nh^d->infinity is sufficient for vanishing variance though not required for the expansion itself. At f(x)=0 the absolute little-o statement still holds. AC_omega is explicit; reader locator correction accepted.
